title: Central Coast Angling
specs: Targets jumbo perch, lake trout, King Salmon seasonally in Lake Michigan and Grand Traverse Bay

services.name: Perch Trips
services.desc: Come join us as we target jumbo perch. A fun catch and even better eating, the spring perch season lasts approximately 60 days. Bookings begin March 1st and usually wind down around May 1st. Fall season starts the last week of September and comes to a close December 15th. We do accept bookings throughout the winter months as long as the air temps are above freezing! All skill levels are welcome as Captain Bob is an excellent and patient instructor. Your captain is also quick to bait your hook so your fingers will stay dry and warm! At the end of your trip we will clean your perch for you and Ages 6+ • Up to 4 anglers • 5 hours • Private charter

services.name: Salmon Trolling
services.desc: Max 4 guests per trip Join Capt. Bob on the pristine gin clear waters of Lake Michigan and target the king of the lake, the Chinook salmon. Trolling techniques apply. We will provide top quality gear and use the latest technology available to get the king of kings on the end of our lines. Watch as the sun rises/sets over land marks such as North and South Manitou Islands, South Fox Island or the Leelanau Peninsula. Nothing quite compares to the scenery of northern Lake Michigan in the summer months as we chase the silver fish that are sure to test our tackle. Please remember gratuities are Ages 6+ • Up to 4 anglers • 5 hours • Private charter

blurb: Central Coast Angling offers fishing charters exploring the western side of northern lower Michigan. They target various species seasonally, including jumbo perch, lake trout, and King Salmon. Trips include visits to picturesque towns and focus on maximizing fishing success within a 45-minute radius of Traverse City.
